capabilities: Insert numbered sidenotes into the left or right margin
Add unnumbered margin notes anchored to text
Edit sidenotes and margin notes directly in the margin
Configure numbering styles, spacing, and responsive margin layout
Export notes to PDF with sidenotes laid out in the margin
disambiguation: Not side-panel comments; the notes render in the page margin next to the anchored text.
extras: PDF export is labeled experimental. The README lists known issues: the 'Restart numbering after each heading' feature does not work, and changing style settings can make editing-mode sidenotes disappear until restart. Editing in Reading mode was removed because edits could silently fail to save.
intentEvidence: FelixHT's Obsidian Sidenotes Plugin - hasn't been updated in a while - one user reported it doesn't fully function any longer
motivation: The author wanted sidenotes that survive web publishing, choosing HTML spans because it was simple to make them work in web-published notes; existing callout-based approaches were rejected for that reason.
problem: Obsidian renders Markdown footnotes at the bottom of the note, with no built-in way to place asides in the margin next to the text that references them.

relations.evidence: I did build some of the functionality in my plugin based on this.
allows you to add comments to a piece of text, and this is viewable in the side panel
I did not use a custom callout like this because I wanted the sidenotes to also be publishable
I use Digital Garden to publish a subset of my notes to a website

summary: Tufte-style sidenote plugin that renders numbered sidenotes and unnumbered margin notes in the page margin, editable in place.
